question: Can an outcome-blind public-source search freeze two independent all-real RGB-D source families that each contain one geometry-positive and one geometry-below-reference 10-second window for later old-versus-R1 confirmation?
non_goals: reading or running RCLE RGB algorithm outcomes
changing the 0.01 per-second threshold or the causal three-pair confirmation rule
changing rotation compensation, Sparse LK, local affine fitting, observable support, or pair evaluability
using synthetic or rendered depth as all-real confirmation data
tuning source order or windows after RGB outcome access
Android, real-time, human, product, or safety authority

data_partitions.identity_basis: Official metadata, license, sensor, timing, pose, file-tree, size and hash records only; exact candidates will be frozen in a pre-payload candidate-lock amendment.
data_partitions.reuse_policy: Only exact sources and sequences that remain free of claim-relevant geometry, RGB visual review and algorithm outcome access may advance to a new F2 confirmation contract.

constraints.description: Every candidate must be a real sensor capture with continuous RGB, metric depth, timestamps, intrinsics and timestamped 6-DoF pose that can be aligned without RGB algorithm outcome access.
Candidate ranking and geometry selection may not read preview images, RGB member bytes, RCLE or materially overlapping algorithm outcomes, or unfrozen geometry results.
Exactly two ancestry-independent source families must each supply one geometry-positive and one geometry-below-reference selected window.
constraints.rationale: Two sources are the minimum that can expose a source-specific failure while preserving a within-source positive-versus-below comparison.
constraints.calibration_source: The user-authorized external-confirmation objective and the four-window development design.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: A pooled one-source cohort is never promoted; adding more sources requires a new protocol version rather than adaptive extension.
constraints.revision_policy: Frozen before candidate metadata search and not changed after any candidate payload or geometry access.

constraints.description: Each selected source family contributes exactly one 10-second positive window under the frozen geometry rule.
constraints.rationale: One positive window per source preserves the original two-positive total while making source-level reporting mandatory.
constraints.calibration_source: The existing four-window development cohort, with the authority unit changed from pooled role median to per-source and per-window reporting.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: All eligible windows remain in the geometry ledger, but only the deterministic earliest feasible tuple is selected; no result-driven extra window is added.

constraints.description: Each selected source family contributes exactly one 10-second below-reference window under the frozen geometry rule.
constraints.rationale: One below window per source preserves the original two-below total and prevents a positive-only source from being rescued by another source's low-reference data.
constraints.calibration_source: The existing four-window development cohort and the requirement that pooled aggregates cannot rescue a source.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Insufficient below evidence yields SOURCE_ROLE_INCOMPLETE; thresholds or windows are not relaxed.

constraints.description: Each selected window contains at least 90 source-consecutive pairs over 10 seconds and no selected pair has dt greater than 0.100 seconds.
constraints.rationale: The frozen 0.25-second onset-delay gate is not physically evaluable when a three-pair causal confirmation is driven by substantially slower observations.
constraints.calibration_source: The slowest positive development window ran at 10 Hz and added 0.200 seconds.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Cadence is read from source timestamps before RGB outcome; slower sources are reported ineligible rather than resampled.
constraints.revision_policy: Frozen before candidate metadata search and never changed for this evidence version.

constraints.description: At least 80 percent of the fixed source-consecutive pair denominator in every selected window has valid frozen geometry.
constraints.rationale: A role label must describe most of the fixed window rather than a small evaluable subset.
constraints.calibration_source: The existing all-real geometry admission and holdout contracts.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Continuous coverage and abstention locations are retained; missing pairs are not imputed and the 0.8 threshold is not swept.

constraints.description: A selected positive window has at least 0.80 fixed-denominator pairs at or above 0.05 per second and a longest continuous positive run of at least 5.0 seconds.
constraints.rationale: The positive role must be sustained and materially above the unchanged 0.01 per-second trigger threshold.
constraints.calibration_source: The frozen motion-diverse RGB-D geometry admission rule.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report the continuous signed-radial distribution; do not sweep 0.05, 0.80 or 5.0 seconds in this version.

constraints.description: A selected below-reference window has at least 0.80 fixed-denominator pairs below 0.01 per second and a longest continuous below run of at least 5.0 seconds.
constraints.rationale: The below role must remain below the unchanged algorithm threshold for most of the fixed window.
constraints.calibration_source: The frozen motion-diverse RGB-D geometry admission rule.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report the continuous signed-radial distribution; do not sweep 0.01, 0.80 or 5.0 seconds in this version.

constraints.description: The pre-payload candidate lock contains no more than four source families and two exact sequences per family, with at most 40 GiB cumulative download budget.
constraints.rationale: The bound preserves enough disk and review capacity for implementation and one-shot confirmation while preventing an adaptive unbounded source hunt.
constraints.calibration_source: Current host storage headroom and the minimum two-source four-window design.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Budget exhaustion returns EXTERNAL_COHORT_NOT_EVALUABLE; it does not trigger threshold relaxation or a post-outcome candidate extension.
constraints.revision_policy: May change only in a new pre-outcome source-discovery version with a new candidate lock.

successor_policy.pass_successor: Freeze exact selected source, sequence, window, member and implementation identities in a new F2 confirmation contract before any selected RGB algorithm outcome access.
successor_policy.not_evaluable_successor: Stop this source-discovery version without RGB access; do not relax role gates, slide windows or append candidates after budget exhaustion.
successor_policy.invalid_successor: Preserve the invalid evidence version and repair only the execution contract in a separately reviewed version.

experiment_design.minimal_discriminating_experiment: Freeze an official-metadata candidate order, process exact payloads in that order with fixed non-overlapping geometry-only windows, and stop when two sources each provide one positive and one below window or the frozen budget is exhausted.
experiment_design.resource_budget: At most four source families, two exact sequences per family and 40 GiB cumulative download; no RGB algorithm execution.
experiment_design.stop_conditions: Stop immediately after two role-complete independent sources are sealed, or return EXTERNAL_COHORT_NOT_EVALUABLE when the frozen candidate list or budget is exhausted.
experiment_design.efficiency_strategy: Use official metadata before payload, stream pose/depth without RGB decode, retain every candidate-window disposition, and avoid repeated archive random access.

hypotheses.theoretical_or_empirical_basis: The development cohort found sustained positive and below roles in real data, but prior same-source holdouts showed that source motion programs can be role-imbalanced.
hypotheses.causal_difference: Requires both roles inside each of two new source families before any RGB outcome, rather than pooling positive-only and below-only sources.
hypotheses.expected_information_gain: Separates algorithm generalization from a source's motion-program composition and makes a source-specific failure visible.
hypotheses.minimal_test: One deterministic geometry-only pass through the frozen candidate list.
hypotheses.evaluation_metric: Count of ancestry-independent source families with exactly one selected positive and one selected below-reference window.
hypotheses.falsifier: Fewer than two source families satisfy both frozen roles within the source and resource budget.
hypotheses.resource_budget: No more than 40 GiB download and two exact sequences per candidate source family.
hypotheses.stop_condition: Do not add or reorder sources after any candidate RGB algorithm outcome; stop at two complete sources or budget exhaustion.
hypotheses.selection_reason: It directly instantiates the requested all-real cross-source confirmation unit while preventing pooled-only rescue.

failure_learning.observation: No candidate source metadata search or payload access has run under this contract.
alternative_explanations: public real RGB-D sources may lack synchronized metric pose
eligible sources may contain only one sustained motion role
public transport may exceed the frozen resource budget
reuse_candidates: Geometry-incomplete sources may become source-characterization or regression evidence but never replace a selected confirmation window after RGB access.

external_confirmation_design.window_grid: Non-overlapping half-open windows anchored at the earliest synchronized source timestamp; no sliding.
external_confirmation_design.r1_trigger: current and immediately preceding two pairs in the same source/sequence/window are evaluable and each compensated_expansion_median_per_s > 0.01
external_confirmation_design.final_pass_semantics: Logical AND over every applicable window gate and every source role-direction gate; pooled metrics cannot rescue any local failure.
